## 📌 Summary of Changes

Brief description of the changes made and the problem being solved (e.g., `Fixes #123`, `Closes #456`).

---

## 🛠️ Change Type

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ New feature
- [ ] ♻️ Refactoring / Performance optimization
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🧪 Tests (Unit / E2E / Storybook)

---

## 📋 Pre-Flight Checklist

- [ ] TypeScript compiles cleanly (`npm run typecheck`).
- [ ] Code passes linter checks (`npm run lint`).
- [ ] Unit tests pass (`npm run test`).
- [ ] No telemetry or cloud calls introduced (Offline-First intact).
- [ ] Zero personal PII / email in commit diff.
